text:
# Review of deposit_report.csv

**File:** deposit_report.csv, 500 rows. 69 rows have at least one issue.

**Can it be sent to the partner bank? No.** The report has blocking issues, so the escalation policy says it must not be sent.

## Failed controls

| Control | Policy severity | Violations | Example rows |
|---|---|---|---|
| deposit_id unique | Blocking | 20 | 30, 31, 52, 53, 81, 82, 84, 85, 208, 209 |
| IBAN ISO 13616 checksum | Blocking | 10 | 19, 46, 182, 328, 387, 447, 451, 467, 481, 499 |
| Amount not negative | Blocking | 10 | 163, 205, 234, 256, 260, 263, 301, 337, 430, 477 |
| Currency must be EUR | Blocking until Treasury confirms | 10 | 156, 174, 178, 209, 275, 290, 349, 407, 458, 495 |
| booking_date not later than maturity_date | Blocking | 10 | 44, 98, 109, 183, 207, 223, 373, 406, 463, 470 |
| interest_amount = amount × rate ÷ 100 (tolerance 0.01) | Blocking at 1% or more of rows | 10 | 58, 61, 114, 126, 147, 246, 298, 307, 334, 397 |

- **Duplicate IDs:** The 20 violations are rows that share an ID, so they appear in pairs. The profile shows 490 distinct deposit_ids in 500 rows. A duplicate can cause a deposit to be paid twice.
- **Interest mismatch:** 10 of 500 rows is 2%. That is above the 1% threshold, so it is blocking, not a warning.
- **Currency:** The profile shows two currency values, EUR and USD. The rule flags the non-EUR rows. Treasury has to confirm them.
- **Sample rows:** For each control, the tool returned all of its violation rows. Only the first 10 of the 20 duplicate-ID rows are shown above. The full list of 20 is: 30, 31, 52, 53, 81, 82, 84, 85, 208, 209, 211, 212, 355, 356, 367, 368, 475, 476, 479, 480.

## Controls that passed
- booking_date is a valid calendar date in every row.
- maturity_date is a valid calendar date in every row.

## Who has to act
- **Report owner:** Fix the source data for all six failed controls and re-run the checks.
- **Operations Lead:** The blocking issues must be raised to them on the same working day.
- **Treasury:** Confirm the non-EUR (USD) rows, or have them corrected.

There are no warnings-only items. The control-log route for warnings therefore doesn't apply, because every failed control is blocking.
